antiPatterns.name: Identical Card Grids Across Unrelated Content
antiPatterns.description: Applying a 3-column homogeneous card grid to completely disparate information types (e.g. pricing, testimonials, features, blog posts) on the same page.
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Failure to design appropriate information architectures tailored to distinct content types.
antiPatterns.context: Marketing pages, homepages, and product landing pages.
validExceptions: Product catalog search results or blog post archives where items are truly homogeneous.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Detect repeated 3-column CSS Grid or Flex child containers with identical DOM depth across adjacent sections.
antiPatterns.humanReviewRequirements: Verify whether content types are genuinely distinct.
antiPatterns.remediation: Vary compositional layout by content type: use split-screen for features, horizontal quote carousel for testimonials, and comparison table for pricing.

antiPatterns.name: Excessive Bento Grid Overuse
antiPatterns.description: Forcing tabular, transactional, or sequential information into an asymmetrical bento box layout simply because it is visually trendy.
symptoms: Asymmetric card spans containing plain lists or tables
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Subordinating functional readability and data hierarchy to superficial aesthetic trends.
validExceptions: High-level marketing feature overviews where items have varying visual richness.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Detect CSS grid-column spans (2x1, 1x2) enclosing table or form input elements.
antiPatterns.humanReviewRequirements: Assess whether asymmetric spans help or hinder comprehension.
antiPatterns.remediation: Use standard linear multi-column grids or data tables for structured and transactional information.

antiPatterns.name: Excessive Container Inception (Nested Card Syndrome)
antiPatterns.description: Nesting cards inside cards inside panels, creating heavy layered borders and wasted padding.
symptoms: More than two levels of nested bordered containers
Narrow content width due to cumulative padding
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Relying on physical borders rather than whitespace and subtle surface fills to group information.
validExceptions: Draggable Kanban cards within column swimlanes.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Inspect DOM tree for nested elements declaring border or box-shadow with depth > 2.
antiPatterns.humanReviewRequirements: None. Mathematically detectable via DOM depth.
antiPatterns.remediation: Flatten the container hierarchy. Use whitespace (space-6) or subtle background surfaces without borders for inner groupings.

antiPatterns.name: Repeated Centered Hero Syndrome
antiPatterns.description: Center-aligning every single headline, body paragraph, and button group down an entire page, eliminating any consistent visual anchor edge.
symptoms: Ragged left and right text margins on body paragraphs
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Misapplying display hero center-alignment to continuous reading copy.
validExceptions: Standalone modal dialogs or isolated callout banners with at most 2 lines of text.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Inspect text-align: center on paragraphs with text length > 120 characters.
antiPatterns.remediation: Anchor continuous prose and multi-field forms to a strong left vertical edge (in LTR languages). Reserve center alignment strictly for brief headings or isolated hero banners.

antiPatterns.name: Unbounded Line Measure (Extreme Text Width)
antiPatterns.description: Allowing continuous body text to span the full viewport width on large monitors (>75 characters per line).
symptoms: Reader tracking loss when scanning to next line
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Ignoring optical reading mechanics and psycholinguistic measure constraints.
antiPatterns.context: Articles, documentation, blog posts, long form descriptions.
validExceptions: Terminal command outputs or log viewers with horizontal scrolling.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Compute rendered character count per line or check max-width in ch units on paragraph elements.
antiPatterns.remediation: Enforce max-width: 65ch (or max-width: 720px) on prose containers.

antiPatterns.name: Weak Heading Hierarchy & Flat Typography Ramp
antiPatterns.description: Using heading sizes that are barely distinguishable from body text (e.g. h1: 18px, h2: 16px, body: 14px), destroying visual hierarchy.
symptoms: Headings do not pop from page
Reader cannot quickly scan document structure
Page appears as uniform wall of text
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Failure to apply harmonic scale intervals to typographic sizes.
antiPatterns.context: All text-heavy interfaces, documentation, marketing pages.
validExceptions: Ultra-compact monospace data listings where typography is deliberately uniform.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Compute ratio between h1, h2, h3, and body text font-size.
antiPatterns.humanReviewRequirements: Review optical balance with custom display typefaces.
antiPatterns.remediation: Apply a harmonic type scale (Major Second or Minor Third ratio): H1: 30px+, H2: 24px, H3: 20px, Body: 16px.

antiPatterns.name: Proportional Numerals in Tabular Financial Data
antiPatterns.description: Displaying financial figures, stock prices, or tabular metrics using proportional numerals, causing decimal points to stagger and misalign.
symptoms: Ragged decimal alignment in table columns
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Neglecting OpenType tabular numeric features in data-dense interfaces.
validExceptions: Marketing hero headline stating 'Over $1,000,000 Saved' where proportional numerals look more natural.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Inspect computed CSS font-variant-numeric on table cells containing numeric data.
antiPatterns.remediation: Set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums and text-align: right on all numeric data cells.

antiPatterns.name: Inappropriate Font Pairing Clash
antiPatterns.description: Combining two expressive fonts with conflicting historical personalities (e.g. geometric futuristic sans with ornate Victorian serif).
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Combining multiple highly expressive focal typefaces rather than pairing a distinct display font with a neutral workhorse body font.
antiPatterns.context: Brand marketing, editorial sites, landing pages.
validExceptions: Experimental artistic portfolios.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Inspect declared font-family rules across headings and body containers.
antiPatterns.humanReviewRequirements: Evaluate typography harmony with brand personality.
antiPatterns.remediation: Pair an expressive display typeface with a neutral neo-grotesque (e.g. Fraunces + Inter, or Playfair + Roboto).

antiPatterns.name: Low-Contrast Placeholder & Muted Text
antiPatterns.description: Styling input placeholder text, secondary captions, or disabled controls with ultra-light grey (< 3:1 contrast), making it illegible for low-vision users.
symptoms: Faint light grey text (#A0AEC0 or lighter) on white background
Users unable to read field hints
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Prioritizing an ultra-clean minimalist aesthetic over basic legibility and accessibility laws.
validExceptions: Pure decorative watermarks or inactive disabled inputs exempted by WCAG SC 1.4.3.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Compute relative luminance contrast ratio between text color and background color.
antiPatterns.remediation: Enforce minimum 4.5:1 contrast for all essential text, and minimum 3:1 for essential non-text elements and placeholders.

antiPatterns.name: Gratuitous Multi-Color Gradients on Text & Borders
antiPatterns.description: Applying rainbow or neon multi-stop gradients across headings, card borders, and buttons on utilitarian software interfaces.
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Using superficial AI-template decoration to compensate for a lack of structural visual hierarchy.
validExceptions: Consumer AI marketing websites or crypto landing pages where vibrant gradients are intentional brand identifiers.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Inspect CSS linear-gradient declarations on text (background-clip: text) and component borders.
antiPatterns.humanReviewRequirements: Assess whether gradients align with explicit brand direction.
antiPatterns.remediation: Replace text gradients with crisp, solid high-contrast neutral text. Use subtle single-hue tints for card surfaces.

antiPatterns.name: Pitch Black Dark Mode Surfaces (#000000 Glare)
antiPatterns.description: Using pure #000000 black as the background for cards, modals, and canvas in dark mode.
symptoms: Harsh contrast against white text causing halation
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Naive color inversion rather than structured elevation-based surface lightening in dark themes.
validExceptions: High-contrast accessibility mode explicitly requested by user, or ultra-low-power battery modes.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Inspect computed background-color in dark mode for #000000 across multiple elevation levels.
antiPatterns.remediation: Use deep neutral slates (e.g. oklch(0.18 0.01 260) / #121417) for base canvas and progressively lighten surfaces for elevation.

antiPatterns.name: Inappropriate Semantic Status Color Hijacking
antiPatterns.description: Using semantic alert colors (red/green) for non-semantic brand elements (e.g. styled non-destructive buttons in red, or warning messages in green).
symptoms: User hesitation and fear of making destructive errors
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Violating universal chromatic semantic associations.
validExceptions: Brand color palettes where red or green is a non-alert identity color used with distinct secondary signifiers.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Check semantic status component classes against declared button roles and intents.
antiPatterns.remediation: Reserve red strictly for critical errors and irreversible destructive actions. Reserve green strictly for verified success.

antiPatterns.name: Invisible Keyboard Focus Indicators (Outline None)
antiPatterns.description: Removing default browser focus outlines (outline: none or outline: 0) without providing an alternative high-contrast focus indicator.
symptoms: Keyboard navigators unable to see which button is focused
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Prioritizing mouse-only visual minimalism over fundamental keyboard accessibility.
antiPatterns.context: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, tabs).
validExceptions: None. Absolute legal and standard violation.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Inspect CSS for outline: none or outline: 0 without matching :focus-visible declaration.
antiPatterns.remediation: Declare :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } on all interactive elements.

antiPatterns.name: Sluggish & Excessive UI Animations (>400ms)
antiPatterns.description: Applying slow, lingering transitions (>400ms) or bouncy spring animations to basic functional widgets like dropdowns and modals.
symptoms: Users waiting for menus to open
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Confusing decorative cartoon physics with functional UI state feedback.
validExceptions: Game interfaces or playful consumer onboarding celebrations.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Parse CSS transition-duration and animation-duration values.
antiPatterns.remediation: Clamp micro-interactions to 100-150ms and modal expansions to 200-300ms using decelerate easing.

antiPatterns.name: Missing Empty States (Dead-End Blank Canvas)
antiPatterns.description: Displaying a completely blank container or raw 'No data available' text when a list, project, or dashboard has zero items.
symptoms: User has no idea what action to take
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Treating edge states as afterthought rather than proactive guidance channels.
antiPatterns.context: Resource lists, tables, search results, dashboards.
validExceptions: None.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Inspect template conditionals for empty array rendering.
antiPatterns.humanReviewRequirements: Evaluate quality and actionability of empty state message.
antiPatterns.remediation: Provide an actionable empty state with an illustrative icon, explanation of value, and a primary CTA button to create the first entity.

antiPatterns.name: Destructive Actions Without Safeguards
antiPatterns.description: Executing permanent, irreversible data deletions or cancellations upon a single button click without confirmation.
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Missing error prevention and destructive action guardrails.
antiPatterns.context: Account deletion, workspace teardown, database drops, billing cancellation.
validExceptions: Actions with instant 100% reliable Undo toast notifications.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Inspect destructive button click handlers for modal confirmation triggers.
antiPatterns.remediation: Implement a two-step confirmation dialog requiring the user to type the entity name for catastrophic operations.

antiPatterns.name: Unnecessary Floating Blobs & Glassmorphism Blur
antiPatterns.description: Scattering blurred neon gradient spheres (floating blobs) behind frosted-glass cards (backdrop-filter: blur) on utility software.
symptoms: Blurred colorful circles distracting from text
High GPU rendering load and scroll lag
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: AI-template visual gimmickry substituting for rigorous layout and contrast engineering.
antiPatterns.context: Enterprise SaaS, fintech, healthcare, administrative tools.
validExceptions: Artistic portfolio sites or music player visualizers.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Detect backdrop-filter: blur() combined with high border-radius floating elements.
antiPatterns.humanReviewRequirements: Verify if backdrop blur is strictly functional (e.g. frosted sticky navbar).
antiPatterns.remediation: Replace floating blur spheres with crisp, purposeful spatial separation on solid neutral surfaces.

antiPatterns.name: Excessive Pill Buttons & Container Over-Rounding
antiPatterns.description: Applying rounded-full (pill, 9999px) border radius to large cards, input boxes, tables, and buttons simultaneously.
symptoms: Everything looks like a lozenge or pill
Playful toy aesthetic inappropriate for serious tools
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Failure to maintain a coherent corner radius hierarchy.
validExceptions: Consumer social apps, badges, or avatar profile chips.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Compute ratio of border-radius to container height across cards and inputs.
antiPatterns.remediation: Establish a disciplined radius scale: 4px for inputs/buttons, 8px for cards, 12px for modals. Reserve pill radius strictly for small badges.

antiPatterns.name: Generic Hero with Repetitive Icon-and-Text Grids
antiPatterns.description: A centered hero followed immediately by 6 identical cards, each containing a pastel circle, a Lucide icon, a 2-word title, and 2 lines of generic copy.
symptoms: Instantly recognizable as low-effort AI slop
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Lack of bespoke visual direction and realistic product interaction previews.
validExceptions: Simple reference icon tables.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Detect repeated icon-header-paragraph card patterns with identical character counts.
antiPatterns.remediation: Replace generic icon cards with interactive product UI previews, workflow diagrams, or customer evidence.

antiPatterns.name: Excessive Muddy Shadows & Uncontrolled Elevation
antiPatterns.description: Stacking multiple heavy, dark, highly blurred drop shadows across adjacent cards without an elevation token ramp.
symptoms: Blurry dark halos bleeding into neighboring text
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Simulating physical depth without an optical elevation scale or ambient light modeling.
antiPatterns.context: Cards, modals, popovers across all domains.
validExceptions: High-contrast neo-brutalist solid black drop-shadows with 0 blur.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Inspect CSS box-shadow opacity and blur radius values across sibling cards.
antiPatterns.remediation: Implement a disciplined 3-tier elevation token system using subtle, layered ambient shadows (rgba(0,0,0,0.04) to 0.08) with 1px border keylines.

antiPatterns.name: Generic Placeholder Copy & Unrealistic Marketing Claims
antiPatterns.description: Using 'Lorem ipsum' filler, hyperbolic buzzwords ('The Next-Gen Quantum Synergy Platform'), or absurd fake statistics ('10,000% ROI').
symptoms: Lack of concrete user value explanation
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: AI text generators fabricating hype rather than articulating authentic product workflows.
antiPatterns.context: All software interfaces and landing pages.
validExceptions: Early wireframes explicitly marked as draft.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Regex scan for 'Lorem ipsum', 'next-gen', 'synergistic', and ungrounded percentage claims.
antiPatterns.humanReviewRequirements: Assess tone and authenticity of product copy.
antiPatterns.remediation: Write concise, domain-specific copy that describes the concrete problem solved and the exact workflow supported.

antiPatterns.name: Fake Testimonials & Stock AI Avatars
antiPatterns.description: Generating fictional customer quotes with AI-generated headshots and generic praise ('This tool changed my life!').
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Superficial template filler substituting for verifiable social proof.
validExceptions: Design mockups populated with clearly labelled test personas.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Heuristic review of testimonial author attribution and generic quote wording.
antiPatterns.remediation: Use real customer case studies with specific metrics, or replace the section with verifiable architecture diagrams and documentation snippets.

antiPatterns.name: Empty Visual Sections (Decorative Shells Without Workflow Purpose)
antiPatterns.description: Rendering feature sections, cards, or hero graphic containers that contain elaborate decorative illustrations but zero actionable information or workflow utility.
symptoms: Users scanning past decorative fluff trying to find real product capabilities
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Treating interfaces as static graphic canvases rather than functional problem-solving software.
validExceptions: Pure artistic brand splash pages.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Inspect sections with DOM area > 200,000px² containing zero text nodes or interactive triggers.
antiPatterns.remediation: Every visual card or section must contain actionable product data, verified capability descriptions, or interactive previews.

antiPatterns.name: Mismatched Domain Copy & Tone Dissonance
antiPatterns.description: Using playful consumer slang, celebratory confetti copy ('Woohoo!'), or marketing hype inside high-acuity financial, clinical, or administrative interfaces.
symptoms: Cognitive dissonance during high-stress operational or emergency tasks
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Ignoring domain context and user emotional posture in microcopy engineering.
antiPatterns.context: Healthcare EHR, fintech, administration, compliance systems.
validExceptions: Consumer entertainment apps.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Scan text nodes for playful colloquialisms in enterprise/clinical domains.
antiPatterns.humanReviewRequirements: Review microcopy tone against domain requirements.
antiPatterns.remediation: Align tone strictly with domain: objective, precise, and sober language in enterprise/health/fintech; save playful elements for consumer entertainment contexts.

antiPatterns.name: Desktop Layout Merely Squeezed Onto Mobile Viewport
antiPatterns.description: Failing to reflow multi-column tables, side-by-side forms, or complex toolbars on mobile screens, forcing awkward zooming or horizontal scrolling.
symptoms: Horizontal scrollbar appearing on body element
Inputs too narrow to type in
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Designing desktop-first without mobile ergonomic reflow architecture.
validExceptions: Dedicated desktop-only workstation apps explicitly gated on screen width.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Inspect DOM bounding boxes at 375px viewport width for scrollWidth > innerWidth.
antiPatterns.remediation: Reflow grids to 1 column, stack forms vertically, and wrap tables in touch-friendly horizontal scroll containers with sticky key columns.

antiPatterns.name: Cramped Mobile Touch Targets (<24×24px WCAG AA / <44×44px Touch Ergonomics)
antiPatterns.description: Interactive buttons, pagination links, or table action links rendered smaller than 24×24 CSS pixels (violating WCAG 2.2 Level AA SC 2.5.8) or failing to provide recommended 44×44px touch targets on coarse pointer devices (WCAG Level AAA SC 2.5.5 / Apple HIG platform standards).
symptoms: Users struggling to tap small icons on phones
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Assuming desktop mouse precision applies to mobile finger tap interactions.
validExceptions: Inline text hyperlink within a paragraph of running text (exempted by WCAG 2.2).
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Compute bounding box dimensions of all interactive elements on coarse pointer viewports.
antiPatterns.remediation: Enforce a strict minimum target size of 24×24 CSS pixels for WCAG 2.2 Level AA compliance, and expand touch target padding to 44×44 CSS pixels (or 44×44 pt) on touch viewports (@media (pointer: coarse)).

antiPatterns.name: Destructive Text Truncation (text-overflow: ellipsis on Vital Data)
antiPatterns.description: Applying ellipsis truncation to unique identifiers, monetary amounts, or error messages without a tooltip or expansion mechanism.
symptoms: Users see 'Transaction ID: tx_984...' and cannot copy or verify the actual full value
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Prioritizing rigid visual line heights over data integrity.
antiPatterns.context: Financial tables, transaction logs, key-value inspector drawers.
validExceptions: Long URL previews where the domain is visible and a full link copy button is provided.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Inspect text-overflow: ellipsis on elements displaying financial amounts or IDs.
antiPatterns.humanReviewRequirements: Verify if full value is accessible via click/hover.
antiPatterns.remediation: Allow essential identifiers to wrap, break cleanly (overflow-wrap: break-word), or provide an inline one-click copy button.

antiPatterns.name: Desktop-Only Hover Dependency (Touch Inaccessibility)
antiPatterns.description: Concealing essential interactive actions (e.g. edit, delete, share, or dropdown disclosure) exclusively behind mouse :hover states without an alternative trigger for touchscreens.
symptoms: Mobile touch users cannot access core functions because touch displays do not have a continuous hover cursor state
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Designing with desktop-pointer assumptions, ignoring multi-input device modalities.
antiPatterns.context: Table row action bars, card action overlays, navigation menus.
validExceptions: Secondary keyboard shortcut hints that are purely informational.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Inspect CSS for opacity/visibility toggles inside :hover selectors without matching touch tap triggers.
antiPatterns.remediation: Make primary actions permanently visible, or provide an explicit overflow icon button that triggers on click/tap across all pointer types.

antiPatterns.name: Color-Only Communication of Status or Priority
antiPatterns.description: Communicating success, failure, or priority solely through red, yellow, or green dots without accompanying text or unique icon shapes.
symptoms: Plain colored circles representing server status
Form errors indicated only by red borders with no text
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Violating WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1 (Use of Color).
antiPatterns.context: Status badges, validation alerts, table rows, charts.
validExceptions: None.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Inspect DOM for status badge elements lacking text content or aria-label.
antiPatterns.remediation: Pair every color indicator with a visible text label ('Active', 'Offline') and a distinct icon glyph.

antiPatterns.name: Inaccessible Div Buttons Without ARIA & Keyboard Handling
antiPatterns.description: Using <div onClick={...}> or <a href='#'> instead of native <button> elements, breaking keyboard accessibility and screen reader announcement.
symptoms: Interactive elements skipped during Tab navigation
Screen readers announce 'group' or 'link' instead of 'button'
Pressing Enter or Space does not trigger action
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Amateur HTML semantic engineering ignoring web platform standards.
validExceptions: None.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: AST scan for non-interactive HTML tags (div, span) declaring click listeners without role='button' and tabIndex.
antiPatterns.remediation: Use native <button type='button'> elements. Native buttons handle Space and Enter keys, focus order, and screen reader roles automatically.

antiPatterns.name: Missing Form Labels (Placeholder-Only Inputs)
antiPatterns.description: Omitting explicit visible <label> elements and relying solely on <input placeholder='...'> for form fields.
symptoms: Once user begins typing, hint disappears and user loses context
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Treating transient placeholder text as a substitute for permanent semantic form labels.
validExceptions: Standalone global search bar with explicit aria-label.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Inspect input elements for missing matching <label for='...'> or aria-label.
antiPatterns.remediation: Provide permanent visible <label> elements placed directly above each input.

antiPatterns.name: Keyboard Traps in Custom Widgets
antiPatterns.description: Keyboard focus enters a custom dropdown, datepicker, or rich-text editor and cannot exit via standard Tab or Escape keys.
symptoms: Keyboard navigators trapped permanently in a widget and forced to reload the page
antiPatterns.underlyingDefect: Incomplete keyboard interaction event handling in custom widgets.
validExceptions: None. Absolute accessibility violation.
antiPatterns.detectionStrategy: Automated headless browser keyboard Tab navigation loop test.
antiPatterns.remediation: Adhere strictly to W3C ARIA Authoring Practices Guide (APG) keyboard contracts; ensure Tab navigates forward, Shift+Tab navigates backward, and Escape dismisses overlays.
